Energy Exemplar is growing fast around 30% year on year and, that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that’s at home, in the office, or on the move.

We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.

Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together.

About the Position

We’re looking for a high-impact Account Director to accelerate new logo growth across the Brazil and Mexico utilities market. This is a true hunter role - ideal for someone who thrives on opening doors, shaping complex deals, and building long-term strategic relationships in the evolving energy landscape.

You’ll play a pivotal role in expanding our presence across key markets across the Brazil and Mexico power sector. Working closely with the Regional VP, you’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy to define and execute go-to-market strategies, leveraging your industry network, commercial instincts, and consultative SaaS expertise.

This is more than a sales role, it’s an opportunity to influence how leading utilities and energy players navigate market complexity, regulatory change, and the energy transition.

  • Own new logo acquisition across adjacent energy markets, building a strong, self-generated pipeline.
  • Drive full-cycle enterprise sales, from prospecting and discovery through to deal closure and contract negotiation.
  • Develop and execute strategic account plans in partnership with Customer Success and Marketing to unlock expansion and cross-sell opportunities.
  • Engage at all levels—from end users to C-suite stakeholders—using a consultative, value-led approach.

Energy Exemplar is seeking a highly experienced Energy Market Advisor to join the EMEA Solutions team. This is a senior, customer-facing role for someone with deep knowledge of European energy markets who combines technical credibility with commercial judgement. The Energy Market Advisor will translate market developments into customer opportunities, market-specific go-to-market strategies and compelling propositions for PLEXOS.

The role is central to positioning Energy Exemplar as a trusted strategic advisor to energy-market participants. From day one, the successful candidate will track priority markets, understand the short- and long-term drivers of prices and investment, and identify the events and structural changes most likely to accelerate demand for advanced energy-market modelling and decision support.

The successful candidate will engage confidently with utilities, developers, system and market operators, investors, traders, governments and regulators. They will move comfortably between detailed market discussions, executive business issues and commercially focused conversations, helping customers understand how market change affects their organisations and how PLEXOS can support the decisions they need to make.

Key Responsibilities

Market Insight and Advisory

  • Monitor priority EMEA energy markets and maintain a current view of factors affecting short-term prices, market operations and longer-term investment decisions.

  • Identify market accelerators, including regulatory decisions, policy changes, price movements, system constraints, investment cycles and market-design reforms, that create timely customer needs and commercial opportunities.

  • Translate complex market developments into clear implications for defined customer segments, explaining what has changed, why it matters and which business, planning or investment decisions are affected.

  • Act as a strategic market advisor in early customer conversations, establishing credibility and insight before opportunities progress into detailed product or technical discussions.

  • Form, communicate and defend a well-reasoned point of view on market developments and their practical implications for customers.

Go to Market and Demand Generation

  • Partner with regional sales and marketing teams to develop market-specific go-to-market strategies, campaign themes and messaging grounded in current customer priorities.

  • Turn market intelligence into clear customer conversation starters, ensuring commercial activity reflects what is changing in each market and why customers should act now.

  • Help generate top-of-funnel activity through targeted campaigns, executive roundtables, webinars, events, thought leadership and account-based engagement.

  • Represent Energy Exemplar at industry events, customer forums and executive briefings, speaking authoritatively about market developments and their implications.

  • Host webinars and roundtables and contribute articles, blogs, market commentary and other thought leadership across relevant EMEA channels.

  • Help sales teams establish strong opportunity foundations, including a clear problem statement, stakeholder map, value hypothesis, relevant use cases and agreed next steps.

  • Develop outcome-led business cases for adopting or expanding PLEXOS, linking improved modelling capability to better decision-making, organisational efficiency, risk management and commercial value.

  • Support account teams in aligning customer priorities, market context and the most relevant PLEXOS capabilities throughout early-stage engagement.

  • Build trusted relationships with customers, prospects and market stakeholders, bringing external insight back into Energy Exemplar’s product positioning, content priorities and regional strategy.

Modelling Capability Advisory

  • Advise customers on how to establish or mature an internal energy-modelling practice, including priority use cases, operating model, skills, data requirements, governance and phased development.

  • Create reusable frameworks, workshop approaches and executive materials that align investment in modelling capability with strategic business outcomes.

  • Help customers connect advanced modelling to commercial, policy, operational and system-planning decisions.

  • Strong understanding of wholesale-market fundamentals, price formation, market design, system operations and the drivers of long-term investment.

  • Ability to discuss energy-market modelling and its application to commercial, policy, operational and system-planning decisions.

  • Demonstrated success engaging senior stakeholders and translating complex analysis into clear, compelling recommendations.

  • Evidence of contributing to business development through market insight, customer relationships, propositions, campaigns or thought leadership.

  • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to make complex topics accessible to both technical and executive audiences.

Desirable Experience

  • Direct experience with PLEXOS or a comparable energy-market modelling platform; the ability and appetite to develop PLEXOS fluency rapidly is essential.

  • Experience working across multiple EMEA markets and with a broad range of market participants.

  • Additional EMEA language capability.

  • Experience presenting at industry events, leading executive workshops or producing market-facing thought leadership.

  • Strategic communication: adapts detailed analysis into a clear executive narrative and recommendation.

  • Consultative influence: builds trust, challenges constructively and gains alignment across diverse stakeholders.

  • Market curiosity: maintains an active, evidence-led perspective on evolving European energy markets.

  • Collaboration: works effectively across solutions, sales, marketing and product teams in a regional environment.

  • Execution discipline: converts insight into prioritised actions, reusable assets and measurable commercial support.

We are looking for a Senior UX Designer with strong craft, solid research practice, and real experience building AI-powered products. UX research is a core part of this role. You will plan and run studies with domain experts, turning what you learn into clear design decisions. You will also shape how energy analysts, grid planners, and market traders use our simulation and data tools, working closely with product managers, engineers, and domain experts.

UX Research

Research is a key output of this role, not just a supporting task. You will lead the research program for your product areas, working closely with product and engineering teams.

Research Methods

  • In-depth interviews and contextual inquiry: one-on-one sessions with energy modelers, traders, grid operators, and regulators to understand their goals, workflows, and pain points.
  • Moderated usability testing: task-based sessions on prototypes or live builds to find friction points, comprehension gaps, and usability issues.
  • Surveys and concept testing: structured questionnaires to check assumptions and measure satisfaction (CSAT, SUS, NPS) before committing to a full design.
  • Card sorting and tree testing: validate the information architecture and navigation of complex platforms like PLEXOS Cloud.
  • Heuristic evaluation: structured reviews against Nielsen's 10 heuristics and WCAG 2.1 to find issues without needing participant sessions.
  • Pendo analytics: use real product usage data to spot adoption gaps, drop-off points, and friction areas, then connect those findings with qualitative research.

Research Activities

  • Plan and facilitate: write research plans and discussion guides, recruit participants from Energy Exemplar's customer base, and run sessions with energy domain experts.
  • Synthesize: use affinity mapping and thematic analysis to turn raw data into clear insights, separating symptoms from root causes.
  • Share findings: write concise reports with clear recommendations and present them in team reviews and stakeholder meetings.

Research Planning

  • Keep a rolling quarterly research plan that is aligned to the product roadmap, with studies prioritized by impact and risk.
  • Balance discovery research and evaluative research: know when a full study is needed versus a quick concept test. Manage time constraints and select the appropriate research method.

  • Own end-to-end UX across PLEXOS Cloud, PLEXOS Desktop, Aurora, Adapt2, and PLEXOS Intelligence, from discovery through to delivery and iteration.

  • Design AI-native experiences: conversational interfaces, copilot features, intelligent recommendations, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
  • Use vibe-coding in your day-to-day work: tools like Figma Make, Claude, GitHub Copilot, and VSCode with Opencode to prototype fast and make UX changes directly in dev environments.
  • Maintain the design system: keep component libraries, interaction patterns, and design tokens consistent across products in Figma.
  • Turn complex data into clear visuals: design charts, scenario comparison views, time-series dashboards, and simulation result displays.
  • Work cross-functionally: collaborate with engineering, data science, product, and customer success to ship designs that are practical, tested, and aligned to business goals.

Required Qualifications

  • 5-8 years of UX design experience with a portfolio that shows research, information architecture, interaction design, and visual design. Expert in Figma.

  • Hands-on experience with AI design and coding tools: Figma Make, Claude, GitHub Copilot, VSCode with Opencode, or similar.
  • Experience designing complex data visualizations for expert B2B users: dashboards, time-series charts, and scenario comparison tools.
  • Has designed AI-native features such as copilots, intelligent automation, generative UI, or recommendation systems.
  • Design systems experience: component libraries, design tokens, variants, auto-layout, and engineering handoff in Figma.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background designing cloud-native SaaS platforms for technical users or domain experts.
  • Front-end literacy: comfortable reading and writing HTML, CSS, and JavaScript alongside engineers.
  • Nice to have: some familiarity with energy market concepts such as electricity dispatch, capacity planning, grid topology, or commodity trading.
